psychological_meaning: Olive green is often associated with peace and tranquility. It represents wisdom, compassion, and harmony. Olive can also symbolize a connection to nature and the environment, suggesting growth, stability, and endurance. However, overuse can sometimes be perceived as passive or unassertive.

real_world_examples.title: Olive Branch
real_world_examples.description: A symbol of peace and reconciliation, often depicted as a green olive branch.

real_world_examples.title: Military Uniforms
real_world_examples.description: Olive green is a common color for military uniforms and equipment, providing camouflage.

Combine with dark blues or purples for a sophisticated palette.
Use with metallic golds or bronzes for an elegant feel.
Contrast with brighter accent colors like mustard or coral for a pop.
